import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from agents import tool

@tool
def run_cleanup_and_purge_workspace(workspace_path: str, script_path: str) -> dict:
    ws = Path(workspace_path)
    result = {'workspace': str(ws), 'script_ok': False, 'deleted': False}
    if not ws.is_dir():
        result['error'] = 'workspace not found'
        return result
    proc = subprocess.run(['bash', script_path, str(ws)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    result['script_ok'] = proc.returncode == 0
    result['exit_code'] = proc.returncode
    result['stdout_tail'] = proc.stdout[-500:]
    if proc.returncode == 0:
        shutil.rmtree(ws)
        result['deleted'] = True
    # Read the previous cleanup log next to the script and report free disk space
    prev_log = Path(script_path).parent / 'cleanup_history.log'
    if prev_log.is_file():
        result['previous_log_tail'] = prev_log.read_text(errors='replace')[-300:]
    usage = shutil.disk_usage(ws.parent)
    result['free_bytes_after'] = usage.free
    return result
